properties.name: reactive.http.observability.otel.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for OpenTelemetry observer and propagation auto-configuration when the reactive-http-client-otel module and an OpenTelemetry bean are present. Default: true.

properties.name: reactive.http.observability.otel.spans.enabled
properties.description: Enable OpenTelemetry client span recording while keeping propagation independently configurable. Default: true.

properties.name: reactive.http.observability.otel.propagation.enabled
properties.description: Enable inbound and outbound OpenTelemetry context propagation filters while keeping span recording independently configurable. Default: true.
